findings.finding: No verified same-basis expectations mismatch or persistent incremental earnings path.
findings.disposition: Withhold positive entry; accept evidential rejection, not negative-return forecast.

findings.finding: Price/annualized adjusted Q2 earnings supplies the multiple; it is not an independent valuation basis. A one-turn multiple change equals USD24.56/share, larger than either EPS transmission.
findings.disposition: Accept algebra only; withhold price-response bounds, stop, ceiling and expected returns.

findings.finding: Note18 allocates USD95m of USD20847m common-equity income to participating securities; marginal EPS conversion omits a variable allocation.
findings.disposition: Agree supplemental JIR-01; retain as simplified diagnostic, require justified claims/tax/share bridge before valuation.

findings.finding: Earlier dividend.html and price-history.html raw captures were overwritten; seven prior originals match and two mismatch.
findings.disposition: Agree JIR-02; preserve correction/original manifest and bind current dossier to later timestamped duplicates. Missing raw bytes not recovered.

findings.finding: TipRanks USD5.90 and July23 financing filing lack original local captures in reviewed package. September growth comparator is contextual in third-party management transcript.
findings.disposition: Agree JIR-03; exclude unarchived claims from affirmative acceptance. Primary 10-Q cover establishes security independently. Retain transcript attribution and inferential comparator.

findings.finding: External estimates do not prove investors expect strong or weak earnings without a comparator/accounting basis, nor does public guidance establish complete pricing.
findings.disposition: Qualify frozen wording: no verified surprise threshold/edge. Agree JIR-04; cash preference is strategy evidence discipline, not outperformance forecast.

findings.finding: Fixed-numerator RWA stress omits earnings by design; Advanced headroom actually rose USD5.49405bn in H1. LCR declined and June evidence is stale for October.
findings.disposition: Retain conditional stress; do not infer imminent depletion, distributable budget or current survival.
